Hi Papai,

I saw your feed post looking for a Graphic Designer and wanted to apply for the remote role.

I currently work as a Graphic Designer at Ascent Business Solutions, where I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives and built reusable design systems that cut down turnaround time. Before that, I worked as a UI/UX designer at AT Creation handling branding assets and developer handoffs.

You can see my work in my Bounceless case study, a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists, available at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Let me know if you have five minutes to chat about how my print and digital background fits your team.

Ananya
